data.title: Jordi Visser Puts Bitcoin In The Same Bucket As SpaceX, Anthropic And OpenAI, Says ‘None Of Them Make Money’
data.description: Veteran macro investor Jordi Visser said Bitcoin (BTC) is in the same bucket as SpaceX (SPCX), Anthropic (ANTHZZX), and OpenAI (OPEAZZX)—four assets he estimated are worth around $8 trillion combined, none of which turn profits at the moment.In an interview with Anthony Pompliano published on Satur…
